findings.title: Validate original f64 domains before narrowing
findings.detail: Only dt is range-checked before conversion. Finite request numbers are narrowed to f32 before native solver validation, admitting near-boundary values which the established TypeScript boundary refuses. Examples include negative margin rounding to -0.0, horizon just below dt rounding to dt, radius below0.05 rounding to accepted minimum and position above10000 rounding to10000.
findings.remedy: Validate all original f64 scalar/vector/horizon/obstacle domains before narrowing, then retain native geometry checks and solver arithmetic. Test rollback after ignored boundary errors.
